name: Day of Dreams
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 6, cleric/oracle 8, legendary mesmerist 8, mesmerist 6, occultist 6, oracle 8, psychic 8, spiritualist 6, sorcerer/wizard 8, witch 8; Focus supremacy 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components S, M (incense and elixirs worth 500 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one sleeping creature
Duration until target wakes, then 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will disbelief; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

If the target fails its saving throw, the duration of charm effects affecting it are suspended until it awakens. Once it wakes up, it will remain in a dreamlike state, as per dream reality, except as noted above.
